svg.title: From chip IP to board bring-up
svg.desc: Two panels. The top panel shows the path from silicon (IP and RTL design, verification, physical design and tape-out, fab and package, first-silicon bring-up) through the board (design and assembly, board bring-up, controller and PHY bring-up, boot to OS) to software (low-level SoC software, middleware, RF functionality), with hands-on, exposure and upstream-context markers. The bottom panel traces one issue across six layers: RF functionality, middleware, low-level SoC software, SoC subsystem controller, PHY and board interface, with what lives at each layer and how it is observed. Configuration flows down and status flows up.
